items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Buddy was named Joseph Crawford. Something like that.

ctx.x: Huh? Buddy was named Joseph Crawford. Something like that. Yeah. They just went by the little old man petite because he raised it. And then Buddy was Teeba, you know. Both of them, all of them, Teeba. Buddy must have had a good teacher. See, Buddy must have had a good teacher. He must have had, and Buddy was sighted. Make his notes clear, everything. Perfect. I tell him that Buddy was in a tunnel like that, boy. I mean, Luke Armstrong used to be Buddy. Luke was down there at Teeb Spooner, you know, came down. I…
Well, did Buddy play augmenteds and minor sevens?
